name: RZA
notes: 12-bit soul dystopia, and the origin of pitched-up vocal-chunk sampling. The research documents the gear list, the sample-rate tricks and the philosophy, which is why this is `high`. **Degradation is deliberate**: vinyl sampled at raised speed and played back slow to buy sample time on an SP-1200 running 26.04 kHz at 12 bits, with input-stage distortion because the instruction was "make it louder". A model cannot bit-crush, so what carries it is `velocityTiers` pushed hard — accents into the 120s and a main tier well above the genre's — and a melody that is allowed off the scale more than anything else in this batch (`halfStepDissonance` 0.2), because he pitches whole chunks of soul songs up and the keys "sit sharp of source and inconsistently tuned". **The hats are minimal or absent**, which is the one boom-bap kit besides Havoc's that is allowed to stop: `continuous` is false and `fillDensity` sits at 0.28, the floor at which every seed still gets a hat. **The bass is tonic-only** — sustained sub plus low-mid sample rumble, mixed very hot — so `followRootsProb` is 0.96, `passingTones` is empty, and the sub sits in the lowest register in this batch. `percs.lanes` carries `perc` and `tomLow` as that rumble layer, which is a reading of "low-mid sample rumble" rather than a documented percussion part, and is the one INFERRED drum parameter here alongside `openHat`. Harmony is 1–4 bar loops on static `i`, `i–iv`, `i–VI` with detuned piano and violin fragments, and the hook is a pitched-up vocal snippet rather than an instrument, which is why the countermelody leads with `octave_echo`. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set.** This model reached only 377 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds, and every honest lever — chord duration, harmonic rhythm, voicing window — was already open. The reason is the record rather than the authoring: the harmony is stated by the sample rather than by a chord part, so there is one thing to voice. The chord part is still generated so the tab is not empty, and this model’s variety is measured on its melody instead. ⚠ If it ever grows a real progression, delete this flag. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2,4], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
